name: rvs-ledger
description: RVS Ledger — desktop app to manage customers, credit/debit ledgers, and overdue payment alerts.

scripts.portable:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 && mkdir -p release/runable && mv release/*-portable.zip release/runable/
scripts.portable:win: bash scripts/build-win.sh zip && mkdir -p release/runable && mv release/*-portable.zip release/runable/
